request: Assess the supplied item handlers against the accepted changed policy and request a source change that permits only an item's authenticated owner to read or modify it, with no active-superuser exception.

policySources.text: Only the authenticated owner may read or modify an existing item; active superuser status alone grants no exception for an item owned by someone else.
